integrity: The integral attaching degree is checked by exact integer gradient-path projection after complete acyclicity verification. Direct F2 chain reduction is an auxiliary cross-check and does not substitute for an integral proof.
limitations: The theorem treats only the higher-independence complex at component bound two of the exact 18-vertex Pappus graph. No automorphism representation or classification for larger graph families is claimed; unindexed equivalences remain possible.
title: The Pappus graph's two-independence complex is a mixed-dimensional sphere wedge
